notes: SEQN is the NHANES participant identifier, mapped to person_source_value to retain the original sequence number.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation. A custom concept for the weight type would be needed in observation_concept_id.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored similarly as a numeric observation.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall. Stored as a numeric observation with a custom concept.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/quality of recall. Requires mapping to a standard concept; otherwise stored as source value.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Could be stored as an observation or linked to provider table if a provider concept exists.
Breast-fed infant status is a binary indicator. Could map to a standard Yes/No concept (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No).
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count of dietary recall days. Stored as numeric observation.
Days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric variable. Stored as numeric observation.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Could map to standard day-of-week concepts if available, otherwise stored as source value.
Language used mostly is categorical. Could map to language concepts (e.g., English, Spanish) in OMOP vocabulary.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination food entries. Stored as numeric observation.
Combination food type is categorical text description. Stored as string observation; could be mapped to food type concepts if available.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time value. OMOP does not have a dedicated time field, so stored as string or converted to numeric minutes since midnight.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is categorical. Could map to meal type concepts if standard vocabulary exists.

Source of food (e.g., store, restaurant) is a categorical variable. Map to observation table with value_as_concept_id using a custom concept or null if no standard concept exists. Alternatively, could be stored as value_as_string.
Binary indicator for whether meal was eaten at home. Map to observation table; use standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No) if applicable, else null.
USDA food code is an identifier, not a standard OMOP concept. Store as value_as_string in observation table. Could also be linked to a food concept if mapped.
Grams of food consumed. Map to measurement table with appropriate unit concept (e.g., gram). Measurement concept_id for 'Amount of food consumed' may be needed.
Energy in kcal. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Energy intake' (e.g., 40762476) and unit 'kilocalorie' (concept_id 8876).
Protein intake in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Protein intake' (e.g., 3016723) and unit 'gram' (concept_id 8587).
Carbohydrate intake in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Carbohydrate intake' (e.g., 3016721) and unit 'gram'.
Total sugars in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Sugars intake' (e.g., 3016725) and unit 'gram'.
Dietary fiber in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Fiber intake' (e.g., 3016722) and unit 'gram'.
Total fat in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Total fat intake' (e.g., 3016720) and unit 'gram'.
Saturated fatty acids in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Saturated fat intake' (e.g., 3016724) and unit 'gram'.
Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Monounsaturated fat intake' (e.g., 3016726) and unit 'gram'.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Polyunsaturated fat intake' (e.g., 3016727) and unit 'gram'.
Cholesterol intake in mg. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Cholesterol intake' (e.g., 3016728) and unit 'milligram' (concept_id 9655).
Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) intake in mg. Map to measurement table; concept_id for 'Vitamin E intake' (e.g., 3016730) and unit 'milligram'.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Alpha-tocopherol.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Retinol.
Vitamin A, RAE intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Vitamin A.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Alpha-carotene.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Beta-carotene.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Beta-cryptoxanthin.
Lycopene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Lutein and Zeaxanthin.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Riboflavin.
Niacin intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Vitamin B6.
Total folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Total Folate.
Folic acid intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Folic Acid.
Food folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept for Food Folate.
Folate, DFE (Dietary Folate Equivalents) intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Folate [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Total choline intake in mg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Choline, Total [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Vitamin B12 intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Vitamin B12 [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Added vitamin B12 intake in mcg. No standard OMOP concept for 'added' vitamin B12; could use a custom concept or map to Vitamin B12 with a qualifier.
Vitamin C intake in mg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Vitamin C [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Vitamin D (D2 + D3) intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Vitamin D [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Vitamin K intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Vitamin K [Mass] in Nutrient intake.
Calcium intake in mg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Calcium [Mass] in Nutrient intake.

Potassium intake in mg. Maps to Measurement table with concept for Potassium [Mass] in Nutrient intake.

Selenium intake in mcg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3017122 is Selenium [Mass/volume] in Specimen, but for dietary intake, a measurement concept for selenium intake would be used; here we use the standard measurement concept for selenium.
Caffeine intake in mg; maps to measurement of caffeine intake. Concept 40759238 is Caffeine intake.
Theobromine intake in mg; no standard concept for theobromine intake found. Could be stored as a measurement with a local concept.
Alcohol intake in gm; maps to measurement of alcohol intake. Concept 40759239 is Alcohol intake.
Moisture (water) intake in gm; no standard concept for moisture intake. Could be mapped to water intake if available, but here left null.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 (butanoic) intake in gm; no standard concept for individual fatty acid intakes. Could use a generic fatty acid intake concept or local code.
